decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - C13	The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as  Sui - Generis (Storage of Vans/garage) and shall not be used for any other purpose.
Condition : 4 - No Storage of Vans or garaging of Vans activities  shall not take place anywhere on the site except within the  building.
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The parking, loading and turning area in front of Unit 9 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.
Condition : 7 - No additional floorspace shall be formed within the Unit 9 hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - There shall be no storage of Vans out side front and existing parking area in front of the units at any time.
Condition : 9 - When the authorised use of car storage ceases the use shall revert back to one that falls within a B1 B2 or B8 use class.
description: Change of use from warehousing to van storage and hire.
